# Auroflux Technology

> Auroflux Technology ("Delivering Commitments") is an industrial piping contractor and engineering company in Chennai, India, founded in 2007 by Raja Srinivasan. It delivers turnkey industrial engineering solutions: PPR/HDPE electrofusion utility piping, process cooling and chilled water piping systems, compressed air piping systems, industrial piping design and engineering (P&ID, BoM), project execution, maintenance, and turnkey fire fighting systems. Offices in Chennai and Arakonam, Tamil Nadu; serving industries across Tamil Nadu and India.

- Cooling tower, chiller and compressed air dryer maintenance
- Process chiller, FRP cooling tower, dry cooling tower and compressed air dryer supplier
- Turnkey fire fighting system contractor

## Services

- Engineering consultancy: industrial process cooling tower, chiller and compressed air system design
- Project execution and erection
- Cooling and chilled water systems
- Compressed air system design with minimal losses
- Piping design and engineering with calculations, P&ID and BoM
- Repair and maintenance of process chillers, cooling towers, compressed air treatment products (air dryers) and plate heat exchangers
- Complete turnkey fire fighting systems: fire risk assessment and design, hydrant and sprinkler systems, fire alarm and detection, pump rooms, piping and valves, testing and commissioning

## Products

- PPR pipes and fittings
- HDPE green pipes and electrofusion (EF) fittings
- GI, MS and SS pipes and fittings; PVC, CPVC and UPVC pipes and fittings
- Structural fabrication in MS and SS
- FRP cooling towers (GEM, 10 TR to 1000 TR)
- Industrial process chillers (Gem Orion, 1 TR to 30 TR)
- Dry cooling towers / air cooled heat exchangers (GEM, 50 kW to 5 MW)
- Heat pump hot water generators (Aspiration)
- Compressed air dryers (GEM, 10 to 5000 cfm), compressed air filters, electronic auto drain valves
- VFD control panels, FRP tanks (1 KL to 20 KL), Marley HVLS fans
- Drip irrigation: online laterals (IS 12786), inline drip laterals (IS 13488), drip tape and fittings

## Selected projects

- [IMM closed loop cooling system – Southern Polymers, Thirumazhisai](https://auroflux.com/projects/1): South India's first plate heat exchanger based closed loop cooling system for injection moulding machines
- [IMM closed loop cooling with gravity flow – United Industries](https://auroflux.com/projects/2)
- [IMM closed loop cooling system – GM Pens, Pondicherry](https://auroflux.com/projects/3)

- [Chiller and cooling water system revamp – Mainetti India](https://auroflux.com/projects/6)
- [Hybrid adiabatic dry cooler and PHE cooling system – Ashok Leyland, Chennai](https://auroflux.com/projects/7)

## FAQ

- What does Auroflux Technology do? Industrial piping and engineering in Chennai: PPR/HDPE electrofusion utility piping, process cooling and chilled water systems, compressed air piping systems, and turnkey fire fighting systems, from design to commissioning.
- Is Auroflux an industrial piping contractor in Chennai? Yes. Chennai office in Iyyapanthangal, godown in Vanagaram, registered office in Arakonam; projects across Tamil Nadu and India.
- Do you install compressed air piping systems? Yes – compressed air system design for minimal pressure loss, PPR ring mains (e.g. Nordex India), plus GEM compressed air dryers, filters and auto drain valves.
- Do you build process cooling and chilled water piping systems? Yes – closed loop cooling with plate heat exchangers, cooling tower and chiller piping, chilled water systems (e.g. Southern Polymers, Funskool, TAFE).
- Do you offer industrial piping design and engineering? Yes – calculations, P&ID and bill of materials, plus project execution and piping erection.
- Does Auroflux do repair and maintenance? Yes – process chillers, cooling towers, compressed air dryers and plate heat exchangers.
- Which brands does Auroflux supply? GEM, Gem Orion, Aspiration and Marley.
- When was Auroflux founded? 2007, by Raja Srinivasan.
- How do I get a quote? Call or WhatsApp +91 79043 59589, email raja@auroflux.com, or use https://auroflux.com/contact.
